Sells to contractors, building owners, industrial finishing shops and aerospace OEMs, mainly through distributors and direct accounts, from its own plants.

primary_products.value: roofing membranes; insulation boards; liquid waterproofing coatings; spray finishing equipment; wire and cable assemblies

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: roofing and waterproofing systems, spray finishing equipment, interconnect products serving different customers
